postShow.title: Vendor dump
postShow.body: A vendor's folding tables collapse into fire-sale energy. Quick flips, quicker cash.

postShow.title: Beer share
postShow.body: Someone's cooler runneth over. Your crew accepts communion from the lot.

postShow.title: Burrito angel
postShow.body: A burrito angel appears with foil-wrapped mercy. Hunger delayed, vibe improved.

postShow.title: Lot fam hookup
postShow.body: Lot fam slides you a little something for the next leg. No questions, all love.

postShow.title: Parking ticket
postShow.body: Orange slip on the windshield. The city always collects its encore.

postShow.title: Miracle sticker trade
postShow.body: You trade stickers like currency and walk away with a miracle ticket someone didn't need.

postShow.title: Quiet lot
postShow.body: The lot exhales. Vendors packing, stragglers humming. Nothing wild — just space to hustle.

lot.title: Clown Juice Mafia has arrived!
lot.body: Skull-painted cart under a palm tree. Buy balloons ($30) or try to make a deal (3 for $10) — haggle at your own risk.

lot.title: Lot buzz
lot.body: Vendors shouting, tape decks humming, someone selling pins out of a hatchback. Normal shakedown energy.

lot.title: Quiet lot
lot.body: The lot's mellow. Time to scout prices and plan the hustle before showtime.
